bias.zh: 偏空 · 守住 100 日均线

read.en: Marvell fell 1.6% on Oct 15 to $241.24, recovering from an intraday low of $227.31. It is below its falling 5-day ($259.3) and 10-day ($268.6) averages and the 30-day ($251.6), and just above the rising 100-day ($240.6) and 200-day ($175.2). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and is above zero with a widening histogram, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($291.3), and RSI is 43.
read.zh: 迈威尔 10月15日下跌 1.6%，收于 $241.24，自盘中低点 $227.31 回升。股价位于下行的 5 日（$259.3）和 10 日均线（$268.6）以及 30 日均线（$251.6）下方，并略高于上行的 100 日（$240.6）和 200 日均线（$175.2）。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴之上，柱状图扩大，抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$291.3），RSI 为 43。

read.en: The close slipped into the $240–244 support zone from the last read and under $242, but held the 100-day average after an intraday break. Resistance is $244 (Jun 9 low), then $251.6–254.6 (30-day average, Aug 27 high) and $259.3 (5-day). Support is $240.6 (100-day), then $227.3 (Oct 15 low) and $200.6 (Sep 1 low). A close below $227 would open $200.6.
read.zh: 收盘跌入上次分析的 $240–244 支撑区并跌破 $242，但在盘中跌破后收盘守住 100 日均线。阻力为 $244（6月9日低点），其次 $251.6–254.6（30 日均线、8月27日高点）和 $259.3（5 日均线）。支撑为 $240.6（100 日均线），其次 $227.3（10月15日低点）和 $200.6（9月1日低点）。若收盘跌破 $227，将打开至 $200.6 的空间。
